title: When the Terminal Sings
author: Marguerite Brightwater
blurb: Elodie Nystrom, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
